Resolves #20127

🌿 *A vessel no longer opens for a pane nobody ever built.*

Dragging out a tab whose lazy card never showed now carries a live pane into the vessel. `TearOut` gains an optional `materializePane` host seam, which the detached terminal awaits before it commits `detachItem`. `dock.Workspace` fills it by loading the parked card config through `layout.Card#loadModule`, the primitive that activation and #20110's reconciler already use, so a tear-out racing the card's own load joins it. A host whose pane already exists answers nothing and keeps the synchronous commit.

Evidence: L3 (real-browser drag of a never-shown lazy tab in a downstream dock app: red on the pinned engine, green on this branch) → L3 required (AC1 vessel arrival). No residuals.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline `pr-body` runs in CI. Change class: capability.

size-guard-growth: src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs — the host half of the materializePane seam: finding a parked card config needs the host's dock tree and document, which only the Workspace holds

## Deltas from ticket
- The wait guards more than the ticket's vessel re-check. A duplicate terminal commits nothing (the `materializing` slot), and a retirement still in flight also wins (`retirement.vessel`). `a vessel retired while its pane loads commits nothing: closed, still closing, or its owner gone` pins all three.
- `layout.Card#loadModule` now clears `isLoading` on every outcome. Each caller owed that cleanup after a rejection, and `Card`'s own activation path never paid it. The `container.Base` and reconciler copies are deleted, so this PR adds no third one. `InsertLazyModule.spec.mjs` still pins the flag through the insert path.
- `commitDetach(vessel)` is the old terminal body, extracted so the terminal can call it after the wait.

- Full unit suite (`--workers=1`): 5543 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** Issue [#20127](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20127), changed-file list on PR `#20130`, and current `dev` source of [`src/layout/Card.mjs`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/layout/Card.mjs), [`src/dashboard/dock/window/TearOut.mjs`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/dashboard/dock/window/TearOut.mjs), and [`src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** `TearOut#onDockTearOutTerminal` should await an optional host `materializePane(itemId)` hook before committing `detachItem`, guarding against duplicate terminal arrivals while materialization is in flight and re-verifying vessel liveness (`activeVessel === vessel`, not in `retirement`, not `isDestroyed`) after the await before committing or retiring. `Workspace` should implement that hook by checking `resolveLivePane(itemId)` first and otherwise delegating to the containing tab card layout's `loadModule(config, index)`. `Card#loadModule` should own `delete item.isLoading` in `.finally()` so rejected imports never leave `isLoading: true` stuck on the parked config, retiring the caller-side `.catch()` deletes.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches the expected shape across `TearOut.mjs:914-935`, `Workspace.mjs:1335-1343`, and `Card.mjs:302-307`, while preserving the synchronous commit fast-path when `materializePane` returns a non-thenable (`null`).
*   **Premise Coherence:** coheres: friction→gold and accretion defense — centralizes `delete item.isLoading` at the owner (`Card#loadModule`) and deletes the two duplicate caller-side `.catch()` cleanups in `container.Base` and `Reconciler`.
